overview: You read two bills on one post. The Rose has Longshanks again today. The Theatre's Thursday bill is up early, title only, the tragedy of King Richard the Second, by the Lord Chamberlain his Servants. No maker's name. You do not go to the Rose.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the Rose's bill and the Theatre's, and did not take either down.
